label: BatteryMaintenanceConfig
info:
Battery Maintenance Config - Registers 211-214

Values:
- 211: Battery control mode (0=voltage, 1=capacity, 2=no_battery)
- 212: Wake up (0=enabled, 1=disabled - inverted!)
- 213: Resistance [0-6000] mΩ
- 214: Charge efficiency (0.1% scale)
